lines.zh: 背帆一立，我顺着河岸走。
lines.en: My sail up, I walk along the bank.
My long snout skims the surface.
My sail stands up in the wind.
I step into the shallows.
Water splashes my flank.
I walk off the bank into the river.
My tail sweeps through the water.
I sink to half my height.
I climb back onto the bank.
The mud gives way deeply.
I follow the waterline a while.
Steady going, steady footing.
My passing startles the river birds.
I skirt a stretch of fast water.
My sail dries above the river.
My snout points at the water.
Waiting for fish to pass.
My sail soaks up the sun.
River water runs between my legs.
I watch without moving.
My claws dig into the riverbed.
The grass on the bank sways.
I stare at my reflection on the water.
My long snout cuts the river.

lines.zh: 浅滩的泥陷下我的脚印。
lines.en: The shallows sink under my footprints.
I grind my teeth in the shallows.
I raise my head toward the far bank.
A bird landed on my sail.

lines.zh: 我河里和岸上都追得上你。
lines.en: I can chase you in the river and on the bank.
My nostrils sniff you above the water.
I can walk both land and water.

lines.zh: 你的长矛还不如我的牙。
lines.en: Your spear is shorter than my teeth.
You smell of fish.
You stepped back onto the bank.
My sail's shadow falls over you.
I'm the only one on this river.
Can you swim faster than I do?
A few steps back will do.

lines.zh: 我能从水里冲上你的岸。
lines.en: I can charge out of the water onto your bank.
Your prints are too near the water.
I backed into the water.
A tear in my sail.
I can bear this.
Blood spreads into the river.
Beads of water fly off my scales.
I can still lift my long snout.
In the water I have the advantage.
That struck very heavy.
I shake my sail once.
I still haven't given ground.
Is that thing a fish?
I only want to eat fish.
Throw it into the water.
Too small for one mouthful.
Blood belongs in water.
I don't eat things from the bank.
Keep it further off. Don't wave it.
I want something swimming in water.
That thing in your hand is too dry.
My river has plenty of fish.
Splashes hit my long snout.
My leg is thicker than your waist.
Back off. I need to turn.
You brushed against my sail.
I squeezed past from the water.
That splashed you all over.

lines.zh: 我的背帆立着，一步踏进浅水。
lines.en: My sail stands tall as I step into the shallows.
My snout brushed your shoulder.
The water's stirred too muddy to see.
Any closer and it won't be a bump.
The season isn't here yet.
My territory matters more.

lines.zh: 我的同类只在水边出现。
lines.en: My kind only appears by the water.
I even guard my own eggs.
There's nothing to say on the bank.
Half my time is in the water.
I go back to watching the water.
Your question is too light.
I don't intend to answer.
I slowly turn my head away.
I flip it up with my snout.
I grab it, and it slips free.
Fish. I'll take it.

lines.zh: 太重了，叼不动，我拖到浅水里。
lines.en: Too heavy to lift; I drag it into the shallows.
I sweep it into the river.
Sail up, I move on land and in water.
This bone has some use.
I swallowed it in one gulp.
This is tiny beside my foot.
The sail on my back cuts the water.
Something's moving under the surface.
And a little on the bank.
I've marked it already.
This is just close enough to lunge.
I'm coming from upstream.
First I sink into the water.
You haven't seen my sail.
There's only one path along this river.
I'm easing toward the bank.
I've lowered myself.
Your shadow is on the water.
That angle is best for a bite.
I'm in no hurry. Nothing hunts me.
It's ten paces ahead of me.
It's still on the bank.
I'm half in the water.
I move along the riverbed.
The river muffles my movement.
It's looking down at the water.
Once it reaches the water, enough.

lines.zh: 我在水里和岸上一样自在。
lines.en: Water and land suit me equally.
My sail is showing.
It backed off half a step.
I keep my head low to the surface.
I've measured this step.
It's running upstream.
There's no way around.
I'm waiting for it to lower its head.
I'm very patient for this.
I quicken my pace along the riverbed.
Only the final lunge left.
I lunge up out of the water.
One sweep of my snout and it's down.

lines.zh: 我背上的帆，在水里也能立着。
lines.en: My sail stays upright even in the water.
This comes with water and mud.
My claws have it pinned.
My long jaws close.
It kicked my snout.
I toss it aside with a shake.
The water's all splashed up.
That bite caught nothing.
I press down and it goes still.
I drive up at it from the water.
It's bolted into the brush.
My sail took a scrape.
One more bite will do it.
It slipped into deep water.
I rise up from the riverbed.
Water runs down my sail.
I stand mid-river.
Every bird on the bank took flight.
I shake my long snout.

lines.zh: 河岸上留下了我的脚印。
lines.en: My prints mark the bank.
The water here is just cool enough.
I survey this stretch of river.
I rise out of the reeds.
The smell of fish comes off the water.
Half of me is on the bank.
I move slowly, barely disturbing the water.
Both banks are quiet.
The river runs around my feet.
My shadow falls on the water.
I lower myself, eyes just at the surface.
Fire scorched my sail.
I crashed off the bank into the shallows.
Water too deep. Even I'm dragged down.
The blast threw the water apart.
An arrow, right in my flank.

lines.zh: 那光在皮肤上烧了一圈。
lines.en: That light burned across my hide.
There are no fish left in this river.
Lightning entered the water; my scales went numb.

lines.zh: 我的鳃在干空气里发紧。
lines.en: My gills tighten in the dry air.
